entities.name: Ray Lyman Wilbur
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ray Lyman Wilbur was an American medical doctor who served as the third president of Stanford University and as the 31st United States Secretary of the Interior under President Herbert Hoover, also a Stanford alum.
